objective: Separate continuous-OI estimand misalignment from algorithmic randomness and training-sample variability on matched synthetic representations.
scope: Experiment-only. No public OverlapIndex or Vertebrae behavior is changed.

data.latent_distribution: U standard normal; representation signal Z=U+tau*eta with tau=sqrt(1/q^2-1) for q>0

methods.description: Current continuous OI on row-L2-normalized observed features
Locked broad-RFF prototype-free null-adjusted multibandwidth kernel-alignment score
Existing SAVE target-moment continuous OI diagnostic

selector.shared_data_contract: All methods and algorithm seeds use identical rows, targets, and fixed fold indices within a panel.
selector.sampling_variance_contract: Training sample seed varies while evaluation rows, candidate quality, family, folds, and algorithm seed remain fixed.

predictive_truth.source: Analytic conditional-mean R2 evaluated on the fixed independent evaluation draw; no selector score or fitted head defines truth.

systematic_misalignment.interpretation: Fail if a method systematically disagrees with analytic predictive truth or assigns materially separated scores to equal-utility control candidates.

algorithmic_variance.interpretation: Flag if algorithm seeds alone produce more than 0.025 mean score standard deviation.

sampling_variance.interpretation: Flag if independent training samples produce more than 0.050 mean score standard deviation.

gates.classification: Systematic misalignment is assessed on seed-averaged candidate scores; algorithmic and sampling variance are assessed separately from their frozen perturbations. No post-outcome method or parameter is selected.
